verdict: The script performs extensive fingerprinting and sends identifiers to multiple third‑party domains without consent, posing privacy and PCI risks.
summary: Collects canvas, WebGL, audio, and navigator data, then exfiltrates a generated UID and fingerprint to an ingest endpoint and three partner URLs via sendBeacon and image pixels. No consent check is performed.

text: Generates a persistent unique identifier stored in a first‑party cookie (_pm_id).
Collects canvas, WebGL, and AudioContext fingerprints, plus detailed navigator information.
Exfiltrates the collected profile using navigator.sendBeacon to https://ingest.pulsemetrics.io/v3/e.
Synchronizes the identifier with three partner domains via image pixel requests.

data: uid cookie value, fingerprint hashes, page URL, referrer, navigator profile

title: Fingerprinting without user consent
impact: Enables cross‑site tracking and device profiling, violating GDPR/CCPA consent requirements.
recommendation: Remove or disable all fingerprinting functions (canvasFP, webglFP, audioFP) or implement a consent gate before execution.

title: Persistent identifier set without consent
impact: Creates a long‑lived cookie (≈2 years) that can be used to track users across sites, breaching GDPR/CCPA.
recommendation: Require explicit consent before setting the _pm_id cookie or use a session‑only identifier.

title: Data exfiltration to third‑party domains without consent
impact: Sends potentially sensitive profile data (including device fingerprints) to an external server, increasing breach surface.
recommendation: Restrict sendBeacon to first‑party endpoints or add consent verification before sending.

title: Cookie‑sync pixel requests to multiple partners
impact: Enables cross‑domain tracking and data sharing with ad networks, violating privacy regulations.
recommendation: Remove partner pixel sync or make it conditional on user consent.

pci: Fails PCI DSS 6.4.3 and 11.6.1: script collects and transmits device fingerprints and persistent IDs on a payment page without proven security controls or consent, increasing attack surface.
privacy: Violates GDPR/CCPA by setting long‑lived cookies and transmitting fingerprint data without a lawful basis or user consent.

text: Eliminate the entire PulseMetrics tag from payment pages; replace with a consent‑managed analytics solution.
If retention is required, load the script in a sandboxed iframe with limited permissions (allow-scripts, allow-same-origin) and no network access.
Add a consent check before calling collect(); abort if user has not opted‑in.

policy: script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; connect-src 'self' https://ingest.pulsemetrics.io; img-src 'self' https://sync.adnexus-partners.com https://match.datastream-exchange.net https://beacon.audience-graph.io;
notes: Restricts script loading to the known CDN and limits outbound connections to the ingest endpoint only; partner domains should be removed or gated by consent.

note: Write key used in partner sync URLs.
